name: Dark Parables: The Red Riding Hood Sisters - Collector's Edition
storyline: Play as the fabled detective and defeat the Wolf Queen in Dark Parables: The Red Riding Hood Sisters! Centuries ago, the first Red Riding Hood defeated the wolf and established the Order of Red Riding Hood Sisters. Recently, the nefarious Wolf Queen entrapped the sisters and planned to unleash legions of ravaging wolves onto our world. Assist the Red Riding Hood Sisters in this thrilling Hidden Object Adventure game!
summary:
Discover the Red Riding Hood Sisters!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version. The Collector’s Edition includes:
- Integrated Strategy Guide
- Bonus Gameplay
- Extra Puzzles
